card details microinteraction

Product·by @bodya_zhk·2026-08-24·inspora page·original post

What it is

Card details sheet (fintech): dark wallet app with a metallic silver Visa card peeking at top; tapping Details raises a 'Card details' sheet over a blurred, dimmed home screen - rows (Cardholder name, Card number, Expiry) each with a Copy button; the whole backdrop gaussian-blurs while the sheet is up, and dismissing reverses it.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-25%
Home: avatar + 'Earn $50' chip, silver Spark Visa card art (metallic gradient, subtle noise), balance 5,293.00 in tabular figures with .00 de-emphasized, 4 action buttons (Receive/Send/Details/Scan QR), Transactions list.
25-45%
Details tapped: background blurs heavily (20px+) and dims; dark sheet slides up from bottom over it: 'Card details' title, rows with Copy buttons.
45-70%
Sheet settles ~55% height; rows readable: James Mitchell / 4113 1192 7819 4114 / 02-29; backdrop blur holds.
70-100%
Sheet slides back down; blur and dim release in sync; home restores crisp.

Build prompt

Build a card-details sheet interaction. Home (dark fintech): metallic card art top (silver linear-gradient with brushed noise texture + brand marks rotated 90deg), balance in 32px tabular numerals (cents at 50% opacity), 4 circular action buttons, transactions list. Tapping 'Details': animate two things linked to ONE progress value (0->1): the sheet's translateY (100% -> 45% of screen) and the backdrop's gaussian blur (0 -> 20px) + dim (0 -> 40% black). Spring damping ~28, no bounce past target. Sheet: #161617, 20px top radius, grabber notch, 'Card details' title, then label/value rows (Cardholder name / Card number / Expiry date) each with a right-aligned 'Copy' button - tapping Copy morphs the label to a check + 'Copied' for 1.2s. Drag-to-dismiss: sheet tracks the finger and the backdrop blur decreases proportionally (progress-linked, not time-based); releasing past 40% velocity snaps it closed.

Mechanics

trigger
Details button tap; sheet dismiss (drag/tap outside)
elements
home screen, backdrop blur+dim layer, bottom sheet with copyable rows
properties
backdrop blur radius + opacity, sheet translateY, row copy button state
timing
sheet up 400ms spring; blur syncs with sheet progress (drag-linked)
easing
spring (damping ~28); blur interpolates 0->20px linearly with sheet travel
loop
no
